description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Canon Medical Research USA, Inc. is a research and development organization creating next-generation medical imaging systems. The Embedded Software Engineer will develop image-processing software for large medical devices across the full software lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, and documentation. The role also supports image reconstruction, scientific and mathematical algorithms, performance optimization, and vendor coordination in a regulated medical device environment.
Embedded C/C++ engineer implementing image reconstruction algorithms and unit-testing scientific software

Responsibilities:
• Analyze software requirements documentation and consult with the requirements author as needed
• Formulate a software design using industry best practices and document it appropriately
• Implement the software design in C/C++
• Design and execute unit test plans to verify coded software
• Contribute to image reconstruction and scientific/mathematical algorithm implementation, including performance optimization
• Coordinate communication with vendors related to project materials
• Contribute to the creation of software requirements and specifications
• Contribute to the corporate IP portfolio

Requirements:
• B.S. or M.S. degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering from an accredited institution
• Entry-level: 0-2 years of professional experience
• Strong academic background in applied mathematics is required; linear algebra and numerical methods coursework or project work is required
• Candidates should have coursework, internship, or project experience (academic or personal) in most of the following:
• Computer architecture: memory hierarchy, cache behavior, instruction pipelines, and how they affect software performance
• Operating systems / systems programming: processes, threads, scheduling, synchronization primitives
• Multi-threaded / parallel programming: experience writing correct, race-free concurrent code; exposure to multi-processing or parallel algorithm design
• C/C++: solid fundamentals; comfort with memory management and low-level debugging
• Numerical methods and linear algebra: ability to translate mathematical algorithms into efficient, numerically sound code
• Strong analytical problem-solving skills, particularly with mathematically dense algorithms
• Initiative and solution orientation; comfortable working through ambiguity
• Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to document design decisions
• Effective relationship building across a cross-functional engineering team
• Sound time and task management

Preferred:
• direct experience with a preemptive multitasking RTOS is a plus
• Image processing and/or GPU programming experience is a plus (CUDA, OpenCL, or similar)
• Familiarity with version control, defect tracking tools, and peer code review is a plus
